## What this layer claims

A mandatory proposition is a controlled row whose text contains one of ['mesti', 'wajib', 'perlu', 'hendaklah', 'tidak boleh', 'dilarang']. A definitional statement is a row containing one of ['ialah', 'adalah', 'merujuk kepada', 'bermaksud']. Both are quoted verbatim with the row ID that carries them. Neither is an assessment item — an item needs a stem, a key and distractors, and those are left PENDING_UNIT_EXCEPTION_REVIEW rather than guessed.

Batch 1's propositions and stems were hand-authored after reading every unit. These eight are derived by the published rule above, quoting rows verbatim. The rows are the same quality; the analysis over them is shallower, and the models say so in `model_depth`. Rumusan beats, dialogue verdicts and assessment items are `PENDING_UNIT_EXCEPTION_REVIEW`, not guessed.
